panels.title: a: Top-50 cited calculators, correctness (Logic, Interp.)
notes: Unit tests Q1-Q5: correct (external, blue) for all five in CHADS2, FIB-4, TIMI, CURB-65, CATR, GNRI, Canadian-CT, HEMORR2HAGES, RCC Prognosis, ATRIA, DAPT, BARD, FI, 1-year Prognosis, Candida Score, IPSET-thrombosis; IPF only Q1 external, IMDC Prognosis only Q3 external.
Unit tests all five incorrect: COTE, LVAD Risk, ISIS, VIS. Partial incorrect: ABCD Q5; AL Prognosis Q2 and Q4; RRT Index Q4. All other rows are correct (internal, green) for Q1-Q5.

Coverage covered on both MDCalc and Others: CHADS2, FIB-4, TIMI, CURB-65, MELD, Canadian-CT, IPF, HEMORR2HAGES, RCC Prognosis, ATRIA, DAPT, MELD-Na, IMDC Prognosis. Others only: CATR, GNRI, SCORTEN, 4-year Prognosis, ISIS, FI, 1-year Prognosis, Candida Score, IPSET-thrombosis, CRB-65. MDCalc only: BARD. All other rows uncovered.

description: Quality and coverage evaluation of RiskCalcs calculators: (a) the 50 most cited and (b) a random sample of 50. Each heatmap shows correctness of logic and interpretation, unit-test results Q1-Q5 and MDCalc/Others coverage; a bar chart beside each shows citation counts.
uncertain: Heatmap cells for Q1-Q5 unit tests and MDCalc/Others coverage were not written as individual points (about 7 of 9 cells per row, roughly 700 cells); their patterns are summarised in the notes of panels 1 and 3.
Bar values are estimated from pixel positions, and the smallest bars in panel b are approximate.
